card.name: Partway through foreign or rare words
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of non-English or unusual words, such as Lao script, Dutch, German, Latin or Malay words, and technical error codes. It fires on the piece before the word is finished.

modes.label: Foreign words
modes.description: Inside a non-English word, such as Dutch, German, Malay or Latin.
modes.example: Die topmannen moeten gew<<oon>> effe dimmen met die bonussen

modes.label: Lao script and Greek
modes.description: Inside Lao or Greek letters that are split into pieces.
modes.example: ສັນຕິພາບ ເ<<ອ>>ກະລາດ ປ

modes.label: Technical names
modes.description: Inside error codes or borrowed names such as Bézier.
modes.example: E<<INTR>> The call was interrupted by a signal.
